meta.one_liner: The Golden Cross's faster cousin: buy when the 12-day EMA crosses above the 26-day, exit on the cross back down.
meta.explainer_md: MACD — moving average convergence divergence — boils down to one question: is the fast (12-day) exponential average above the slow (26-day) one? When the fast line crosses above, the MACD line crosses zero and the trend is said to be turning up; this strategy buys that cross and holds until the fast average drops back below the slow one. Exponential averages react quicker than the simple 50/200 pair, so it catches turns earlier — at the cost of more whipsaws in choppy markets. Compare it with the Golden Cross on the same symbols and see the trade-off yourself.

spec.name: MACD Trend (12/26)
